title: 1980 AHSME Problem 24
statement: For some real number \(r,\) the polynomial \(8x^3-4x^2-42x+45\) is divisible by \((x-r)^2.\) Which of the following numbers is closest to \(r?\)

solutions.text:
The polynomial factors as \[ \begin{aligned} &8x^3-4x^2-42x+45\\ &\qquad=(2x-3)^2(2x+5). \end{aligned} \] Thus the repeated root is \(r=\frac{3}{2}=1.5,\) and the nearest listed number is \(1.52.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
